end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting waste, explaining compost pits, saving water, and keeping school areas clean and safe. They correctly identified peels, leaves, rice, and tea leaves as wet waste, and plastic and paper as dry waste. The mix-up that plastic can rot in a compost pit remained after the last check, and the idea that a dripping tap wastes very little water was not corrected. At home, ask Anika to explain why plastic stays out of compost and to check whether a dripping tap should be reported.
